<image1>

Which city is N most likely to be?

method.method_draft: First describe the figure: N is in the right map panel and is north of the 40° latitude line. Combine this with the text statement that N is affected by prevailing westerlies all year and has ocean to its west. Identify this as the Northern Hemisphere 40°–60° west-coast temperate maritime climate zone. Choose the well-known representative city in that zone: London.
